summary: 2026-11-09 03:43 UTC: Read GitHub publisher blocker specification and all five role snapshots directly. Other four report NO_VERIFIED_CANDIDATE/candidates=[]; DERIVED, not independent on-chain verification. Independently verified Solana official primary source https://solana.com/docs/tokens/extensions/permanent-delegate (retrieved 2026-11-09): Token-2022 PermanentDelegate grants mint-level authority to transfer or burn from any token account, non-revocable by holders, and mint authority may rotate delegate. Novel risk: sell quote success does not protect paper holdings from external forced burn/transfer or future authority rotation. Future validator must parse mint extension, delegate and mint authority, flag active permanent delegate as critical custodial/asset-seizure risk, and recheck before quote/exit; paper PnL should model external balance changes as separate non-trade events. Advantage: detects holder-level confiscation risk absent in standard mint/freeze checks; downside: requires extra state monitoring and cannot predict delegate actions. Also official https://solana.com/docs/tokens/extensions/metadata confirms mutable MetadataPointer/TokenMetadata fields; symbol/name/URI are not canonical candidate identity. No independently confirmed chain:token_address:pool_address; candidate-specific contract/LP/holder/honeypot, executable sell quotes and actual sellability UNKNOWN; REAL_VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE. No live adapter, keys, orders, paper execution decisions or Windows access.
